environment.label: Environment
environment.hint: For example vacuum, toxic or cold:extreme. Make up your own with lowercase words joined by - or :.

limitedDuration.label: Limited Duration (hours)
limitedDuration.hint: Hours per charge when armor only partly protects. Only used with Limited Protection on.

counters.label: Counters
counters.hint: For example vacuum, underwater or toxic. Must match exactly: thick doesn't cover thick:severe.

level.label: Level
level.hint: Limited still protects, but drains charges faster. Resistances and save bonuses don't count as protection.

limitedDuration.label: Limited Duration (hours)
limitedDuration.hint: Hours per charge. Needed for Limited.

limitedProtection.Name: Enhanced Rules: Limited Protection
limitedProtection.Hint: Armor alone only buys time in a vacuum or severely thin air (4 hours per charge) and underwater (1 hour per charge). Upgrades like a Filtered Air Supply can protect you fully.

keepPartialCharges.Name: Enhanced Rules: Keep Partial Charges
keepPartialCharges.Hint: Switching protection off keeps what's left of the current charge. When off, it's lost, as in Player Core.

ancestryProtection.Name: Enhanced Rules: Ancestry Protection
ancestryProtection.Hint: Creatures that don't breathe are also immune to vacuum and toxic air. Features like the android's Constructed cover vacuum and all thin and thick air, and the cosmic trait covers thin air too. When off, ancestries work as written.

panelEdge.Name: Status Panel Position
panelEdge.Hint: Where your status panel sits on the screen. Only affects you.

disableSf2eAutomation.Name: Disable SF2e Automation's Environmental Protection
disableSf2eAutomation.Hint: Turns off SF2e Automation's environmental protection so only this module handles it. Its other features keep working, and its macros use this module instead. Effects it already made stay until deleted.

Notifications.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character first.
Notifications.NotProtective: {armor} has no environmental protection (it has the Exposed trait).
Notifications.NoCharges: {armor} has no environmental protection charges left. Recharge it first.
Notifications.TargetOne: Target one ally to transfer a charge to.
Notifications.TransferSelf: Target an ally: you can't transfer a charge to yourself.
Notifications.NoSpareCharge: {armor} has no whole charge in reserve to transfer.
Notifications.TargetFull: {armor} is already full: it can't take another charge.
Notifications.NoGM: A GM must be connected to transfer a charge.

Chat.Transferred: {source} connected their armor to {target}'s and transferred an environmental protection charge, complete after 1 minute of connection. {source} has {left} charge(s) left.

Effect.On: {armor} is protecting you. One charge lasts {hours} hours at the current rate.
Effect.Reserve: Charges in reserve: {charges} ({time} at the current rate).
Effect.PartialKept: {percent}% of a partly used charge is kept for next time.

Compat.Sf2eAutomationIncomplete: SF2e Enhanced Environmental Protection couldn't fully disable SF2e Automation's environmental protection (missing: {functions}). That module may have changed; both may now be active.

EditCharges.Hint: A fraction is part of a charge. Setting 0 while protection is on switches it off.
